name: Onee-chan (tachi) wa Osewa Saretai!
original_name: お姉ちゃん（たち）はお世話されたい！
source:
The main character is going to college this year. He is going to leave his parents' house and start living alone, which he has longed for! But then...

The contract he signed with his parents has been cancelled, and he has to move into an apartment he doesn't know. The place he moved to is where his three step sisters live. They are all complete messes in their personal lives and have been bothering him when they were at their parents' home.

He is forced to live with them and they expect to take of them just how he did back home. He does not want to and is trying to find another place to live. The sisters want to be taken care of, and will try to keep the virgin protagonist from leaving by doing naughty things to him.

Thus begins the struggle of the protagonist to take care of the useless sisters.

[From [url=http://clockup.net/product/]official site[/url]]
translation:
主角今年要上大学了。他要离开父母的家，开始一个人生活，这是他向往的！但后来…

他与父母签订的合同被取消，他不得不搬进一套他不认识的公寓。他搬到的地方是他的三个继姐妹居住的地方。他们的个人生活一团糟，在父母家里时也一直困扰着他。

他被迫和他们住在一起，他们希望像他在家里一样对待他们。他不愿意，正在努力寻找另一个住处。姐妹们想要被照顾，就会通过对处男主角做出调皮的事情来阻止他离开。

主角为了照顾无用的姐妹而展开的斗争就这样开始了。
